rules.source_quote: whose names are on the Below Poverty Line (BPL) list
rules.note: Alternative to the income test (R03): BPL list OR annual income below 21000. The rule format cannot express OR.

rules.source_quote: whose annual income is less than ₹21,000
rules.note: Alternative to the BPL test (R02): BPL list OR annual income below 21000. The rule format cannot express OR.

rules.source_quote: The applicant should be a citizen of India.
The applicant should be a domicile / permanent resident of the state of Maharashtra for at least 15 years.
rules.note: The 15-year minimum cannot be held by the profile; only residence in the state is encoded.

unresolved: R02 and R03 are alternatives (OR); a rule engine that treats every eligibility rule as required would wrongly reject people who meet only one of them.
